scenarios.name: Benign SIP Call
scenarios.expected_result: Call establishes, RTP reaches gateway, ML runs, call connects, clean teardown
scenarios.observed_result: Streamed 250 RTP packets; clean Asterisk teardown

scenarios.name: Synthetic Voice SIP Call
scenarios.expected_result: RTP delivered, AASIST runs, policy evaluates, uncorroborated risk cap observed, clean teardown
scenarios.observed_result: Delivered 250 packets; policy observed under uncorroborated cap

evidence.scientific_limitation: Phase 5.3 established that live VoIP benchmark validates real-time pipeline execution and robustness, but does NOT establish class-discriminative EER/AUC. Uncorroborated single authenticity signal caps risk at 38 points, producing ALLOW under standard policy.

scenarios.name: Challenge Issuance
scenarios.expected_result: Challenge created, prompt selected, caller muted, Asterisk playback started, window opens
scenarios.observed_result: Prompt 'sound:challenge_question_digits' played; caller muted; playback ID b722b3b5-ef64-4aa7-8462-46629b1463f1

evidence.challenge_text: What are the last 4 digits of your registered mobile number?

scenarios.name: Challenge Success
scenarios.expected_result: Response within window, transcript satisfies challenge, state CHALLENGE_PASSED, result submitted
scenarios.observed_result: Caller matched target phrase; state advanced to CHALLENGE_PASSED; result submitted

scenarios.name: Challenge Timeout
scenarios.expected_result: Strict cutoff on silence, timeout result submitted, late audio cannot alter state
scenarios.observed_result: Silence triggered CHALLENGE_TIMEOUT; late audio ignored; result submitted

scenarios.name: HOLD -> ALLOW
scenarios.expected_result: Call placed on HOLD, then restored under ALLOW; call stays alive; clean teardown
scenarios.observed_result: Channel placed on hold, unheld, remains active until caller BYE; resources clean

scenarios.name: BLOCK Enforcement
scenarios.expected_result: BLOCK triggers ARI channel termination, caller receives SIP BYE, clean teardown
scenarios.observed_result: Gateway issued the configured ARI channel termination action, resulting in SIP BYE and channel destruction; zero orphan resources

scenarios.name: RTP Inactivity Watchdog
scenarios.expected_result: Watchdog detects RTP stoppage after configured 5.0s, hangs up caller with reason='normal', no false fraud verdict
scenarios.observed_result: Watchdog fired after 4.97s inactivity (configured 5.0s); caller received BYE (hungup=True); zero leaked resources

scenarios.name: Backend WebSocket Failure
scenarios.expected_result: Gateway detects WS loss, initiates fail-safe teardown (reason=congestion), no false fraud verdict
scenarios.observed_result: Fail-safe teardown executed; caller received BYE (True); resources clean

scenarios.name: Asterisk Resource Reconciliation
scenarios.expected_result: Selective reconciliation reaps VoiceShield-owned resources while preserving foreign resources upon gateway recovery
scenarios.observed_result: Owned bridge was reaped; foreign bridge was preserved intact upon gateway recovery

evidence.reconciliation_scope: Gateway startup selective reconciliation (validates reaping owned Stasis resources without stopping Asterisk daemon)

scenarios.name: SIM Call Screening
scenarios.expected_result: Automated CallScreeningService tests pass; metadata screening latency < 5ms; no cellular audio interception
scenarios.observed_result: CallScreeningEvaluator unit tests passed; Phase 3.1 Realme 8 physical evidence verified; metadata-only screening boundary confirmed

evidence.physical_device_source: Phase 3.1 Authoritative Physical Evidence (no new physical SIM run in Phase 5.4)

metadata_screening_metrics.system_limitation: Android OS sandbox strictly prohibits third-party recording of cellular voice audio. VoiceShield CallScreeningService screens incoming call metadata ONLY (contact lookup, blocklist, STIR/SHAKEN). Phase 5.4 validation utilizes automated Android unit tests and previously established Phase 3.1 physical Realme 8 evidence.

scenarios.name: Frontend State Consistency
scenarios.expected_result: 7 Jest suites pass; risk_update state, threat indicators, reconnection consistent
scenarios.observed_result: All 94 Jest tests passed; state consistency intact

scenarios.name: Incident Persistence
scenarios.expected_result: Incident persisted, session linked, SHA-256 integrity hash verified
scenarios.observed_result: Incident bcfd08d8-2735-4cc1-931f-3955e0d15faa verified; SHA-256 integrity hash matches exactly

scenarios.name: Manual Audio Analysis
scenarios.expected_result: Manual audio analysis tests pass under real ML pipeline mode
scenarios.observed_result: All 21 manual analysis tests passed; multi-window inference verified

scenarios.name: Clean SIH Demo Rehearsal
scenarios.expected_result: Controlled deterministic demo-call lifecycle runs cleanly to teardown; timings measured
scenarios.observed_result: Controlled deterministic demo-call lifecycle/rehearsal completed in 5.122s; zero orphan channels/bridges

evidence.lifecycle_scope: Controlled deterministic demo-call lifecycle from call establishment to clean teardown; does not represent human setup duration

scientific_limitations.eer_auc_claim: Phase 5.3 established that controlled VoIP benchmark validates real-time pipeline execution and robustness, but does NOT establish class-discriminative EER/AUC.
scientific_limitations.gsm_claim: Android OS sandbox prohibits third-party raw cellular voice interception. VoiceShield operates via controlled VoIP Asterisk ingestion and Android incoming-call metadata screening.
scientific_limitations.perfection_claim: No 100% deepfake detection or infallible spoof detection is claimed. Scenario pass rate does not imply deepfake detection accuracy.
